title: Sandhill Charters
specs: Boat is a 25-foot Boston Whaler 250 Outrage with twin Mercury 200hp supercharged outboards
Equipped with wireless man overboard protection system
Full bow to stern sun shades and onboard flushing toilet
Tours include narrated history, luxury estates, marine life, and snorkeling at Peanut Island
No alcoholic beverages or glass containers onboard (insurance policy)
No smoking or THC products onboard
No aerosol sunscreen or dark tanning oils/lotions
Clean, non-marking boat shoes, sandals, or barefoot
Private charters for up to 6 guests
includes: Cooler with ice and bottled water
Complimentary towel service, goggles, floats (available upon request)
Snorkeling access at Peanut Island (where applicable)
blurb: Guests enjoy private, narrated boat tours exploring Palm Beach waterways, luxury estates, and marine life. Tours include stops for swimming and snorkeling at Peanut Island's sandbar. Customizable trips range from 1.5 to 8 hours, including sightseeing, sunset cruises, and ocean ash scattering services.
extraNote: Full refund for cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance · No refunds for cancellations less than 24 hours before or early trip termination by guest · No refunds if captain ends trip early due to misconduct or safety risks · Refunds issued within 24 hours of cancellation, may take up to 30 days to process · Full refund if operator cancels for reasons other than guest misconduct · Lake Park Harbor Marina, just one mile north of the Blue Heron Bridge
